truths.truth: A config with no `stakes` key and no `roles` block resolves ok:true with model, effort, review, verify, reviewer_tiers and reviewer_efforts, and the envelope carries neither `stakes` nor `stakes_set`.
truths.evidence: Hermetic repo /tmp/cadv3 with `.planning/config.json` = `{}` and CADENCE_GLOBAL_CONFIG at an empty file: `node /code/cadence/cadence-core/bin/route.mjs resolve --role cad-executor` returned ok:true, model:null, model_source:"session", effort:"high", agent:"cad-executor", review{plan:advisory,diff:off,risk_surface:blocking,phase_diff:off}, reviewer_tiers and reviewer_efforts all four triggers, verify:"off", and no `stakes` / `stakes_set` key anywhere in the envelope. reason[] names `config.schema.json's roles.cad-executor.effort default "high"` and the four `schema default` gate lines, so the answer comes from the schema and not from a grid.

truths.truth: `config.mjs unset` removes a key from one named layer, honours --global, and is a no-op that changes no bytes on a key the file does not hold.
truths.evidence: In /tmp/cadv3: `config.mjs unset stakes` -> {"ok":true,"file":".planning/config.json","removed":["stakes"]} and the key is gone from the file while `model.effort.executor` survives; `unset stakes --global` -> {"ok":true,"file":"/tmp/cadv3/global.json","removed":["stakes"]} leaving `{}`; re-running `unset stakes` -> removed:[] with md5 before == after (cf2c3b6d9173cc7f44e46e1e8a105e2c both sides); `unset model.effort.executor` removes a nested path. Implementation landed in commit ff9542df.

truths.truth: The plan-time risk floor has exactly two effects - the plan review goes blocking and verify goes on - leaves model and effort at their configured values, names the surface in reason, and the waiver key withholds both.
truths.evidence: Hermetic phase 1 plan declaring `db/migrations/001_init.sql` vs a clean phase 2 plan declaring `docs/README.md`, config `roles.cad-executor = {model:opus, effort:xhigh}`. Risky: review.plan "blocking", verify "on", model "opus", effort "xhigh", agent "cad-executor-xhigh", reviewer_tiers/reviewer_efforts identical to the clean run, reason carries `risk floor: phase 1 plan 1: db/migrations/001_init.sql touches migrations (path segment migrations); the plan review is raised to blocking and the deep-verify pass is turned on`. Clean: review.plan "advisory", verify "off", same model/effort/agent. Adding `review.triggers.risk_surface.waive_routing_floor: ["migrations"]` returned review.plan "advisory", verify "off", model/effort unchanged, reason `every matched surface is waived by review.triggers.risk_surface.waive_routing_floor, so nothing is raised`. Only the two gates moved; diff and risk_surface and phase_diff were byte-identical across all three runs.

human_checks.name: Drive `/cad-config --roles` in a live session on a repo whose global layer has no `roles` key, accept the defaults, then run it again in the repo and change one value
human_checks.expected: Thirteen questions in four AskUserQuestion calls, every question showing its default first labelled `(current)` or `(in force)`; the first run writes all twelve role values plus the floor answer to the user-global file in ONE `config.mjs set --global`; the second run writes only the changed key into `.planning/config.json`. Which file received each write is checkable on disk and is named back to the user before the run ends.
human_checks.why_human: Out of reach: the AskUserQuestion seam only exists inside an interactive host session, so no script or subprocess in this environment can present a question or return an answer. Everything a probe CAN settle was settled - the workflow text, the four-call arithmetic, the twelve catalog rows and the reachability from COMMANDS.md, the skill and both init workflows are all verified; only the seam's live round trip is unexercised.

human_checks.name: Put `stakes: "critical"` back into a scratch repo's `.planning/config.json`, run any Cadence command, and follow the migration the warning opens
human_checks.expected: The retired-key warning appears on the resolve envelope, the workflow opens workflows/config.md's Stakes migration arm rather than relaying the warning, the critical row is shown as twelve explicit per-role values per layer, they are confirmed through the thirteen questions, and `stakes` is absent from every layer file afterwards. A scratch repo with no `stakes` key produces no warning and never reaches the arm.

The scriptable halves are already verified - `check`/`set` refuse the key, `get` and `resolve` both carry the migration pointer in warnings[], `unset` removes it from either layer, and the arm is wired from references/seam-spawn-agent.md:287.
